mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate consistently signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative sentiment shift in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: The joint signal (both HOUST and RSAFS declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as higher interest rates reduce corporate profitability and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services, reducing corporate output and profitability, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signals an environment where central banks may tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 1.5% annually), strong consumer demand (as measured by HOUST and RSAFS) drives corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annual growth > 1.5% and HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.02.
